definition: calm stretching poses with slow breathing
description: A rooftop terrace at sunset, city blocks and potted plants along the parapet, the sun a bright disc low in a hazy orange sky. A woman in a plum top and leggings works through poses on a mat: she folds forward with straight legs and both palms flat on the mat, looking up at the camera; rises into a high lunge with both arms lifted overhead and her gaze up; leans back over a straight rear leg with one arm reaching behind her; sits into a wide-legged forward fold reaching for one foot; and finally lies chest-down along her front leg with both arms stretched out on the mat in front of her.

de.answer: Sie macht Yoga auf einer Dachterrasse.
phrases: beide Arme über den Kopf heben
de.question: Was macht die Frau?
